levels.stable: Supported foundation. Changes require explicit release notes and consumer verification.
levels.beta: Supported for production evaluation, but contract refinement is still expected before 1.0.
levels.experimental: Reference-backed incubation surface. No stability promise before promotion.

..purpose: Factory runtime, API client, authentication bootstrap, and primary hooks.

./auth.purpose: Native authentication, account lifecycle, OAuth, MFA, passkeys, and token storage.

./organizations.purpose: Slingshot organization contracts and query hooks.

./permissions.purpose: Backend authorization and native permission orchestration.

./webhooks.purpose: Slingshot webhook administration hooks and contracts.

./realtime.purpose: Ordered, resumable realtime channels and reconciliation.

./offline.purpose: Durable mutation queues, optimistic state, and synchronization.

./drafts.purpose: Durable drafts, recovery, autosave, and conflict handling.

./media.purpose: Recoverable capture, transformation, upload, and analysis pipelines.

./upload.purpose: Slingshot upload hooks and authorization boundaries.

./push.purpose: Native push registration, lifecycle, and notification-open routing.

./ai.purpose: Durable streaming conversations and reviewed AI actions.

./audio.purpose: Provider-neutral native audio playback and second-screen pairing.

./billing.purpose: Entitlements and injectable native store adapters.

./privacy.purpose: Account data, relationship privacy, export, deletion, and cleanup.

./observability.purpose: Lifecycle telemetry, diagnostics, feature flags, and rollout controls.

./accessibility.purpose: Accessibility contracts, preferences, auditing, and adaptive layout.

./biometrics.purpose: Biometric availability, gates, and fresh-authentication controls.

./deep-links.purpose: Deep-link parsing, routing, deferred intent, and OAuth return normalization.

./theme.purpose: Native appearance, tokens, preferences, and theme hooks.

./ws.purpose: Legacy room WebSocket client and hooks.

./ui.purpose: React Native components, tokens, actions, manifests, and headless UI hooks.

./ui/components/*.purpose: Focused component entry points that avoid loading the complete UI catalog.

./coach.purpose: Opinionated coaching, metrics, goals, training, and entitlement controllers.

./party.purpose: Opinionated party-game controllers, providers, decks, and replay.

./party-session.purpose: Shared-device and separate-device party session primitives.

./community.purpose: Opinionated community hooks, contracts, controllers, and presets.

./community/core.purpose: Headless community state and reconciliation controllers.

./testing.purpose: Deterministic reliability harnesses and fault injection.

./release.purpose: Release control-plane, diagnostics, flags, and rollback helpers.
